* The evolve_loop job type in crons/evolve_loop.py can fail silently due to missing error handling in crons/manager.py, 
* The consequence is that if the evolve_loop job fails, the failure will not be visible, and the system may not adapt to changes as expected, 
* A suggested fix is to implement robust error handling and logging in crons/manager.py to catch and report any errors that occur during job execution.
